products.title: 3M Filtek Z250 Universal Restorative Composite
products.shortDescription: Proven universal microhybrid restorative composite delivering superior strength and aesthetic Polishability.
products.fullDescription: 3M Filtek Z250 Universal Restorative has been trusted by dentists worldwide for more than 20 years. Designed for anterior and posterior restorations, core build-ups, splinting, and indirect restorations including inlays, onlays, and veneers. Offers low polymerization shrinkage for reduced stress on the tooth and lower sensitivity.
features: Hybrid technology with 82% filler by weight (60% by volume)
Exceptional handling: sculptable, does not slump or stick to instruments
Fast curing time of just 20 seconds for 2.5mm depth of cure
Excellent mechanical properties with high flexural and compressive strength

specifications.value: Class I - V restorations, Core build-ups

products.title: Waldent Eco Plus Super Torque LED Airotor Handpiece
products.shortDescription: Push-button high-torque ceramic bearing airotor featuring integrated self-generating LED illumination.
products.fullDescription: Waldent Eco Plus LED Airotor provides daylight-quality illumination directly in the oral cavity without needing an optical fiber dental unit. Features Japanese ceramic bearings for whisper-quiet vibration-free operation, triple water spray for rapid bur cooling, and anti-retraction hygiene head design to protect the cartdrige from aerosol backflow.
features: Self-illuminating dynamo generator LED - no optical unit needed
Ultra-smooth Japanese Ceramic Ball Bearings (380,000 - 420,000 RPM)
Triple water jet spray with effective atomization
Autoclavable at 135°C (275°F)

products.title: Dentsply ProTaper Gold Rotary Files Assorted
products.shortDescription: Advanced gold metallurgy endodontic rotary files offering 2.4x greater cyclic fatigue resistance.
products.fullDescription: ProTaper Gold features the exact same geometries as ProTaper Universal, but incorporates advanced proprietary gold thermal metallurgy. The visible difference is the warm golden shade of the metal; the clinical difference is vastly enhanced flexibility, resistance to cyclic fatigue, and respecting severe canal curvatures without ledging or transporting.
features: Gold metallurgy enhances flexibility and resistance to cyclic fatigue
Progressive taper design optimizes cutting efficiency and debris evacuation
Maintains canal curvature even in acutely curved roots
Compatible with all standard endodontic rotary handpieces

products.title: Woodpecker LED.F Light Cure Curing Unit
products.shortDescription: Wireless ergonomic LED curing light equipped with built-in light meter and OLED display.
products.fullDescription: The Woodpecker LED.F Light Curing Unit delivers intense 1600 mW/cm² optical output capable of curing all standard dental photo-composites in under 5 seconds. Featuring an intuitive charging base with integrated digital radiometer to verify light intensity before clinical use, three functional curing modes, and a long-life lithium battery.
features: High power 1600 mW/cm² broad-spectrum LED output
Integrated base light meter for instant intensity calibration
OLED screen displaying remaining battery and countdown seconds
3 operating modes: Full Power, Ramping, and Pulse
products.packageContents: 1 x Handpiece, 1 x Charging Base with Light Meter, 1 x Optical Fiber Rod, 1 x Light Shield, Adapter

products.title: GC Gold Label 2 (Fuji II) Glass Ionomer Restorative Cement
products.shortDescription: Chemically cured restorative glass ionomer cement with high fluoride release and thermal biocompatibility.
products.fullDescription: GC Gold Label 2 (Fuji II) is the global standard for tooth-colored glass ionomer restorative materials. Ideal for Class III and Class V cavities, cervical erosion, pediatric primary teeth restorations, and core build-ups. Bonds chemically to enamel and dentin without the necessity of etchants or bonding agents while releasing continuous protective fluoride ions.
features: Natural chemical adhesion to dentin and enamel without acid etching
High continuous fluoride release protecting against secondary caries
Thermal expansion coefficient matching natural tooth structure
Excellent biocompatibility and radiopacity
products.packageContents: 1 x 15g Powder Bottle, 1 x 8ml Liquid Bottle, 1 x Measuring Spoon, 1 x Mixing Pad

products.title: Eighteeth E-Connect S Cordless Endomotor with Built-in Apex Locator
products.shortDescription: Brushless motor with integrated apex locator and 340° miniature adjustable contra-angle head.
products.fullDescription: The Eighteeth E-Connect S represents next-generation cordless endodontic technology. With an ultra-miniature 340-degree rotatable contra-angle head and brushless motor, it provides exceptionally quiet, smooth rotation and real-time apical position display on its OLED panel. Supports auto apical reverse, auto stop, and customizable reciprocal angles.
features: High-performance brushless motor: longer lifespan, negligible noise
Integrated dual-frequency apex locator for real-time canal monitoring
Miniature 340° rotatable contra-angle head for unhindered posterior access
Customizable reciprocation mode with adjustable forward and reverse angles
